manual.basic_metal_products.line2: {0}Alloys are specialty metals used in advanced applications, and can be created from grit or in alloying furnaces.{1}
manual.basic_metal_products.line3: Steel is used for structural engineering and decoration, electrum for {0}electrical engineering{1}, and constantan for {2}thermal engineering{3}.{4}
manual.basic_metal_products.line4: {0}Metal plates are a crafting material required for the creation of most machines and components.{1}
manual.basic_metal_products.line5: They are made by hammering an ingot with an Engineer's Hammer or in a {0}Metal Press{1}.{2}
manual.basic_metal_products.line6: {0}Metal rods are a crafting material used in many components or decorations, such as scaffolding.{1}
manual.basic_metal_products.line7: They can be crafted or made in a {0}Metal Press{1}.{2}
manual.basic_metal_products.line8: {0}Wires are the backbone of power transfer and are used in many electronic components.{1}
manual.basic_metal_products.line9: They are made by cutting a plate with Engineer's Wire Cutters or in a {0}Metal Press{1}.
